title: Stellata Notte Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Stellata Notte is a Blue Mountain Beach stunner with private pool, jetted spa and is just 3 minutes to the beach! This elegant, Mediterranean 3-story home has old-world charm, with wrought iron windows, rich dark wood, and touches of marble and travertine.
description_expanded: **SNOWBIRD PROMOTION- Save 50% PER NIGHT January and February for monthly stays!** HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - ACCESS TO THE PUBLIC WIDE BEACH AT BLUE MOUNTAIN WITH NO RESTRICTIONS - Private (heated when requested) pool with jetted spa - Stunning Ocean Views - TVs in all Bedrooms - Short walk to the beach, shopping, and dining - Fully stocked kitchen - Golf cart rental friendly community - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: **Optional Cancellation Protection**- Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($150 fee applies at booking). -Pool/Spa heat available at $250/week in the off-season(Must be heated together) Stellata Notte is a Blue Mountain Beach stunner with private pool, jetted spa and is just 3 minutes to the beach! This elegant, Mediterranean 3-story home has old-world charm, with wrought iron windows, rich dark wood, and touches of marble and travertine. Upon entering the front door, guests are transported to their own spacious, upscale escape. Feel free to bring extended family and friends to this luxurious vacation home, it will comfortably sleep 17. The 1st floor features an open-concept living area with a fully-equipped open kitchen with everything your home chef will need to cook for the whole crew. The dining area seats at least 10 with a combination of upholstered banquette seating and chairs. There is also a convenient king master suite on the main level. Best of all, you can walk right out of the bedroom into the pool area through French doors! The 2nd floor features plenty of sleeping room 3 more bedrooms that can sleep 17. There's more fun on the 3rd floor, where you’ll find a wet bar and access to the Crow's Nest balcony area. Here you can sit high above Blue Mountain Beach enjoying the Gulf views and breezes. BEACH ACCESS Head out of the neighborhood and south on Hwy 83. This road ends at your beach access, Blue Mountain Regional Beach Access . Distance: .1 miles | Time: 3 minutes walking BLUE MOUNTAIN BEACH The Blue Mountain Beach neighborhood has something for everyone. The local creamery has made its mark on this delightful neighborhood - when you come to Blue Mountain, you have to stop for their homemade ice cream. Just a short drive west and you’re close to all the shopping, restaurants, and entertainment of Sandestin, Miramar Beach and Destin. Go east and you can visit all the popular South Walton beach communities of Grayton Beach, Seagrove, Seaside and more. ACCOMMODATIONS (sleeps 17) 1st Floor, Bedroom 1: King bed, Smart TV, patio access. Private bathroom with dual sinks, large shower. 2nd Floor, Bedroom 2: King bed, desk area, TV. Private bathroom with tub/shower combo. 2nd Floor, Bedroom 3: 2 queen beds, TV. Private bathroom with dual sinks and tub/shower combo. 2nd Floor, Bedroom 4: 2 sets of twin-over-twin bunks, 1 twin trundle, 1 queen-over-queen bunk, Smart TV. Private bathroom with tub/shower combo. IMPORTANTA DETAILS ** Sorry, no pets allowed. ** Must be 25 to rent. ** Parking for 3 cars. ** Pool & spa heat can be added for an additional fee of $250/week (must be heated together). During the months of October - May. (Pool temperature must be lower than 80 degrees to heat.) FREE WiFi

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
